items.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024
items.q: he said that I influenced his playing... He told me that he would listen to my stuff and incorporate it into his stuff

ctx.x: Well tell me about — does any of the studio work, like all these people you played with, I wonder if anything sticks out in your mind? Vanessa Williams, Red Hot Chili Peppers, Randy Brecker.
It just goes on and on and on.
